summary: Iteration-10 testing complete. Backend 11/11 pytest green (demo-login idempotent+4 seeded props, Will GET/POST/PDF + 404, car-vs-property new schema XIRR, uc-projection pre_emi_by_builder, breakeven-rtm-uc XIRR+subvention, loan-optimizer leverage_xirr). Frontend Playwright verified: demo login button on /login works and redirects to /app; /app/will page loads with testator/executor/beneficiaries/per-property splits; Save Draft triggers 'Will draft saved' toast; Download PDF button present; AppShell nav has 'Will' link; Calculators page loads all 14 tabs; Car vs Property new full-finance form renders with car_price/car_dp/property_price/property_dp and result cards show 'XIRR (annualized) 17.57%' for property and car XIRR; UC expected value has 'Pre-EMI borne by builder (subvention)' checkbox; RTM vs UC breakeven has subvention checkbox; Landing shows 9-item feature grid; Guide contains Will/Demo/Tenant keywords.

minor.issue: Response is UserOut-shaped and does NOT include 'is_demo' field (DB has it, but UserOut Pydantic model strips it). Review request expected is_demo=true in response. Currently only observable via plan==pro and is_pro==true. If frontend needs to branch on demo state, add is_demo to UserOut.

ui_bugs.issue: React console warning: 'value prop on input should not be null' — some controlled inputs receive null instead of ''. Cosmetic; does not break functionality.

issues: Carried over from it-8/9: Recharts 'width(-1) height(-1)' warning on first chart mount. Cosmetic only.

action_items: Consider adding 'is_demo' field to UserOut Pydantic model so /auth/demo-login explicitly reports is_demo=true (currently stored in DB but omitted from response).
Fix null-value warning on Will.jsx inputs — coalesce null -> '' for controlled fields.
(Carry-over, non-blocking) Set explicit min-height on Recharts ResponsiveContainer parents to suppress width(-1) warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 3991 lines — strongly recommend splitting into routers (auth.py, calc.py, will.py, tenant.py, admin.py, projects.py). Guideline is <700 lines.

/auth/demo-login sets is_demo=true in DB (line 3714) but UserOut (line 147) does not declare the field, so it's stripped from the response. Either add is_demo to UserOut or document that frontend should key off plan=pro.
/will/pdf uses reportlab SimpleDocTemplate synchronously inside an async endpoint — for large Wills this could block the event loop. Consider running in executor (run_in_threadpool).
WillAllocation.splits is typed as List[dict] — consider a proper sub-model (WillSplit) with validated beneficiary_index and percentage (0-100) to prevent bad data.
demo_login endpoint is public (no rate limit) — could be used to mass-create demo sessions. Consider a short-lived IP-based throttle.
loan_optimizer XIRR loop computes _xirr for 20 DP% grid entries on every request — acceptable but could cache when inputs are identical.
test_credentials: admin@estima.com / Admin@123 (admin). demo@estima.com — auto-login via POST /api/auth/demo-login (no password). Fresh random users (TEST_will_*@estima.com) created via /auth/register with Pass@1234 for 404 test.
seed_data_creation: Test run created 1 fresh user (TEST_will_<uuid>@estima.com) + seeded/reused the demo user (demo@estima.com) with its 4 demo properties (Prestige Park Grove 3BHK, Sarjapur Villa, Indiranagar Flat, Koramangala). A Will draft was saved for the demo user. No production data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo user is shared across all test runs; its Will + 4 seeded properties persist in DB. UserOut does NOT expose is_demo — rely on plan=='pro' + email=='demo@estima.com'. Will save uses upsert (idempotent); /will/pdf returns raw PDF bytes starting with '%PDF'. Car vs Property new schema uses car_price/car_dp/property_price/property_dp/monthly_rent; old alias (amount+dp_pct) still supported via fallback. UC pre_emi_by_builder=true returns pre_emi_by_builder_total>0 and reduced pre_emi_by_buyer_total + xirr_pct. Breakeven-rtm-uc returns rtm.xirr_5y_pct and uc.xirr_5y_pct; winner is picked by XIRR; uc.pre_emi_by_builder=true is echoed. Loan-optimizer each grid row has leverage_xirr_pct+leverage_cagr_pct+net_equity_at_horizon; top-level best_leverage_xirr is the max-XIRR row. On frontend, 'Find sweet spot' is the submit button for Loan Leverage Optimizer (not 'Run/Optimize'). 'Show the gap' is the submit for Car vs Property. Car vs Property result renders 'XIRR (annualized)' rows (not 'Car XIRR' literal). Tour modal appears on first /app visit — bypass via localStorage.estima_tour_seen='true'.
